instruction: Enable the option to show weekday on the system clock.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling weekday display on system clock by setting clock-show-weekday to true. The evaluator verifies the gsettings value is 'true'. Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the system setting using 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface clock-show-weekday'
Metric (exact_match) correctly performs string comparison between command output and expected value
Expected value 'true\n' correctly matches the actual gsettings output format (includes newline character)
